snippet.title: Mega Custom Night - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Mega Custom Night is an Ultimate Custom Night fangame built from the ground up without reusing any original code from the base game.

Featuring 80 unique animatronics spanning the first 6 games in the franchise, each with completely original and innovative mechanics.
